threads.title: Geographies of pilgrimage: Meaningful movements and embodied mobilities
threads.snippet: To foreground the transitional state or temporary identity of the pilgrim. This will require conceptual frameworks that acknowledge the liminal, threshold experience of sacred travel.

threads.title: Estimation of the radial force on the tokamak vessel wall during fast transient events
threads.snippet: Below, we will refer to them and disruptions as to fast transient events. The aim of the present work is to estimate the radial force acting on the wall of the tokamak vacuum vessel in such events.

threads.title: Pilgrimage - Sacred Sites, Rituals, Beliefs
threads.snippet: A practice that involves the search for divine favor, temporary release from everyday life, and the potential for mass movement of populations across boundaries.

threads.title: Interpretation of Potential Energy as Field Property
threads.snippet: It's very difficult to pin down where gravitational energy is, but you can loosely think of it as a property of the field rather than the body.

threads.title: The transient force profile of low-speed droplet impact
threads.snippet: The transient force exerted by a low-speed liquid droplet impinging onto a flat rigid surface is investigated experimentally.

threads.title: Pilgrimage beyond the officially sacred: Understanding the geographies of religion and spirituality
threads.snippet: As scholarship examining the lived experiences of pilgrims note pilgrimage's temporary and circular character; a pilgrim returns home. In so doing, the narrative's sacred geography is reinterpreted.

threads.title: How Ions and Molecules Organize to Form Crystals
threads.snippet: The classical nucleation theory provides a powerful conceptual model for understanding the general processes of nucleation.

threads.title: Self-organisation processes in the chemistry of materials
threads.snippet: Stable crystallisation of the superconducting phase by stabilising the nucleation process. In particular, such problems include studies of phase boundaries as self-organising systems.

threads.title: Selective nucleation and self-organized crystallization
threads.snippet: Herewith we will focus on how selective nucleation occurs in crystallization and hence leads to self-organized pattern formation.

threads.title: Consequential creativity: Student competency and lateral thinking in architectural education
threads.snippet: Guilford, who can be considered the founder of modern creativity research, defined divergent thinking as the ability to explore many different mental categories and thus generate novel ideas.

threads.title: Pilgrimage as a rite of passage operates liminality
threads.snippet: Pilgrimage as a rite of passage operates liminality, i.e., transitional space between the material world.

threads.title: Self-Organisation of Prediction Models
threads.snippet: The emergence of symbols and prediction models can be described as a ritualisation transition, a self-organising process. We are at the threshold of something new.
